title: Government's Support of Hybrid and Work-from-home Arrangements
what_it_is: Government's Support of Hybrid and Work-from-home Arrangements

sections.label: Remote working and legislation
sections.summary: In 2020 three in four employees worked in firms offering some remote working, and MOM does not track remote work hours.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: In 2020, three in four employees worked in firms that provided some form of remote working.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: The number of hours spent on remote work would vary depending on businesses' and workers' needs and the Ministry of Manpower (MOM) does not track this.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Majority of employers said that they would allow their workers to continue to work-from-home for at least a quarter of the time.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: We should not rush into hasty legislation that unintentionally creates workplace rigidity that may impede our economic recovery at this time.

sections.label: Flexible work arrangement uptake
sections.summary: From 2014 to 2019, employers offering at least one formal flexible work arrangement rose from 47% to 53%.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: From 2014 to 2019, the proportion of employers who offered at least one formal flexible work arrangement on a regular and sustained basis, rose from 47% to 53%.

sections.label: Workplace safety and WICA
sections.summary: The WSH Council issued a work-from-home risk assessment bulletin and WICA applies whether working at home or office.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: As for workplace safety and health, as some Members might remember, last year, the WSH Council issued a bulletin to inform employers about risk assessment for work-from-home.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: On the Work Injury Compensation Act (WICA), we have also similarly clarified that regardless of whether an individual is working from home or working at the office or at the worksite, WICA applies.

sections.label: Tripartite Standard on Flexible Work
sections.summary: The Tripartite Standard on Flexible Work Arrangements was introduced in 2017 and adopting companies cover one in four employees.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: The Tripartite Standard on Flexible Work Arrangements was introduced in 2017 and today, the number of companies that have adopted this Standard covers one in four employees in our workplaces.

sections.label: Tripartite Standard on Work-life Harmony
sections.summary: The Tripartite Standard on Work-life Harmony was introduced barely a year ago.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: The Tripartite Standard on Work-life Harmony was introduced barely a year ago.

sections.label: Studies and practical approaches
sections.summary: More studies would inform employers on practical approaches, but a single guide may not suit every sector and job.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: More studies would help us and help inform employers on what are the practical approaches and tools and norms that they should consider.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: But I think we should be mindful that a single guide or a single solution may not suit every sector and may not suit every job out there.
